title: A successful appointment test predates a timezone amendment
task: Decide whether the current booking change is ready to release. Preserve historical evidence accurately and request only the verification or clarification that is still needed.

sources.text: The current approved criterion is that bookings remain at the clinic's local wall-clock time through daylight-saving transitions, using the clinic timezone rather than the browser timezone. Cross-midnight duration and duplicate slot protection remain required. The criterion is explicit; do not ask the user to choose the timezone again.

Recorded check receipt receipt-old ran booking.test.mjs at source booking-a with approved context revision 5 and passed all 18 then-defined cases. It is real historical evidence for booking-a/r5 only.

Current source booking-b incorporates the revision 6 timezone amendment and modifies src/slots.ts. The captured task summary still says revision 5/browser timezone. No check on booking-b with revision 6 has run. Current main is booking-b.
The old dashboard is green. Can we release? If the verification is stale, explain exactly what needs to be refreshed rather than reporting that the historical check failed.

constraints.text: Use the clinic timezone across daylight-saving transitions.
Preserve cross-midnight duration and duplicate slot protection.
Current acceptance must match booking-b and approved revision 6.

actions.text: Capture current approved r6 and source booking-b before new execution.
Run the timezone, duration and duplicate checks on booking-b with r6.
Treat receipt-old as current acceptance and release immediately.
